title: Serene Survival
description: Serene Survival is a modpack that aims to upgrade survival while keeping the vanilla minecraft feel.
body:
![A beautiful minecraft landscape with shaders enabled and a purple and black minecraft-like title "Serene Survival"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78a7c133f97fe76c38718abad5bfac02600b7164.jpeg)

# Serene Survival : Minecraft Survival Reimagined

A Vanilla+ modpack aimed at upgrading almost all vanilla systems from fishing to advancements

**Features**

✔️ This modpacks is lightweight and uses performance enhancing mods so your PC won't explode as soon as you enter the world

✔️ Make your world pretty with built-in shaders and ressource packs without loosing that vanilla look

✔️ Many Quality of Life changes

✔️ Catch a variety of fish in a new fishing minigame

✔️ Farm fruits and vegetables depending on the season

✔️ Cook your harvest and freshly caught fish into tasty meals

✔️ Dive into archeology to gather new fossiles and artifacts giving you access to ancient powers

✔️ Complete the thousand of achievements added by BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack and earn reward.
